title: Atomic Energy Commission nuclear secrecy laid over UFO secrecy in the 1950s
place_text: Los Alamos and other nuclear sites

tellings.quote: Yeah, that that's my sense is that in the 50s when the atomic energy commission was set up where all this stuff was going down around Los Alamos and other sensitive nuclear sites, you had basically the overlaying of nuclear secrecy on top of UFO secrecy.
>> I believe nuclear secrecy [music] was used as a Trojan horse for UFO secrecy.
tellings.difference: Calls it a Trojan horse, extends it to the Manhattan Project and DOE, and cites the Atomic Energy Act.
tellings.link_reason: Same theory, told by the same host: nuclear secrecy was laid over UFO secrecy and used to hide it.

as_told.title: Nuclear secrecy as a Trojan horse for UFO secrecy

plain: In the 1950s, the secrecy around nuclear weapons was laid on top of UFO secrecy, so the two were hidden together around Los Alamos, the New Mexico lab where the atomic bomb was built, and other nuclear sites run by the Atomic Energy Commission, the government agency in charge of American nuclear work. Michels offers this as his own reading, once in a conversation with a helicopter pilot named Jake Barber and later in an episode about a Secretary of Energy. The second time he goes further: he calls nuclear secrecy a "Trojan horse" for UFO secrecy, traces it back to the Manhattan Project, the wartime effort that built the bomb, and forward to the Department of Energy, and points to the Atomic Energy Act, the law that set the rules for nuclear secrets. If he is right, the walls built to guard the bomb would also have hidden whatever was known about UFOs.
